rationale: Task asks for code shares of denials that sum to one, so the ranking scope is denied claims rather than all claims (denial_code_carc is null on 11559 of 12845 rows, so an all-claims base would not sum to one over codes). Missing-code quantification is set to by_status because the spec requires overall, among-denied, and per-claim-status counts. Denial rates are segmented by all five named columns (claim_type, provider_specialty, network_status, place_of_service, auth_required_flag) with the adjudicated-claims denominator to match 'claims whose adjudication has concluded', and min_group_size 30 to flag unstable segments as specified. The report prints every rate as numerator / denominator, cites an artifact or metrics key for every number, and carries the required synthetic-data and small-groups caveats plus descriptive_only since segment comparisons are associational, not causal. Single-table task, so no join checks are needed; manifest shows claim_id as a unique key with no null segment columns.
